title: PolicyQuote
description: ION Finance Insurance Offer Extension v1 — placed in Offer.offerAttributes. At publish_catalog time only catalog-level fields are present; per-policyholder quote fields (approvedIDV, annualPremiumIDR, etc.) are populated at on_select time.

inclusions.description: Covered peril codes active in this offer. Must be a subset of the resource's coverageInclusions.

specialExclusions.description: Free-text exclusions specific to this risk profile, beyond the standard exclusions in resourceAttributes (e.g. unregistered modifications, specific use-case restrictions).

requiredDocuments.description: Documents required from the policyholder before policy issuance (e.g. STNK, KTP, vehicle photos).

claimPolicy.description: IRI of the claim filing and FNOL (First Notice of Loss) policy document.

cancellationPolicy.description: IRI of the mid-policy cancellation terms and pro-rata refund schedule.

renewalPolicy.description: IRI of the auto-renewal terms and renewal notice schedule.

endorsementPolicy.description: IRI of the mid-policy endorsement rules (add-ons, vehicle amendment, policyholder amendment).

grievanceSlaPolicy.description: IRI of the OJK-compliant grievance resolution SLA (max 20 working days per POJK 23/2023).

approvedIDV.description: Insured Declared Value approved by underwriter in IDR. Populated at on_select time.

annualPremiumIDR.description: Base annual premium in IDR before add-ons and discounts. Populated at on_select time.

ojkFinalRatePercent.description: Final OJK tariff-compliant premium rate applied (% of IDV per annum). Populated at on_select time.

tariffZone.description: OJK tariff zone applied to this quote. Determined at on_select based on vehicle location.

quoteValidUntil.description: Quote expiry timestamp. Populated at on_select time.

addOnPremiums.description: Selected add-on premiums. Populated at on_select time.

deductible.description: Standard deductible in IDR applied per claim (risiko sendiri).

counterOfferIDV.description: Insurer-proposed IDV if declared IDV was outside acceptable range.

inspectionRequired.description: True if physical inspection is required before policy issuance.

ncdApplied.description: True if No Claims Discount was applied to this quote.
